event: Daily Intelligence Briefing
title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Tech wreck, rotation out of AI, small caps bid.
Core PCE 3.3% YoY vs 3.2% fc and Q3 GDP revised to 4.3% vs 3.5% fc killed the cut thesis, while jobless claims at 18.9k vs 20k fc kept growth fears at bay — and 94% of Polymarket sees a Dec 9 hike. That combination dumped SOXX-heavy exposure while money rerouted into small caps and materials.

INDICES — VIX 26.4, above its 22.6 20-day MA and near the top of its 52-week 13.5-35.9 range.
IJH +1.19% > RSP +0.83% > IJR +0.73% > IWM +0.65% > DIA +0.31% > SPY -0.29% > SOXX -0.50% > QQQ -0.65%; small > large by 1.02pp. Largest cross-asset move: VIX futures +4.44%, with USO +3.29% and TLT +0.92%. Both SPY and QQQ sit below their 200-day MA — a CTA sell trigger that keeps trend followers short into any bounce.

VOLUME & BREADTH — SLV 2.2x, GLD 1.6x and IJH 1.4x are pulling volume; SPY printed 1.33x average and QQQ didn't crack 1.0x — defensive accumulation, not conviction selling. RSP at 1.2x with +0.83% is accumulation, while LT-quality tech saw muted participation. Breadth diverges from the tape: 370/129 adv/dec, 59% above the 50-DMA, 54% above the 200-DMA, up/down volume 1.15, 49 new highs vs 5 lows — the S&P's own constituents are healthier than QQQ action suggests.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLB Materials +2.07%, XLRE Real Estate +0.92%, XLC Comms +0.89%, XLI Industrials +0.83%, XLE Energy +0.74%, XLF Financials +0.71%, XLU Utilities +0.48%, XLP Staples +0.46%, XLY Discretionary -0.20%, XLV Healthcare -0.56%, XLK Technology -0.83%.
MSOS +4.82% and SILJ +4.35% top industries; DRAM -3.03% and MAGS -1.05% bottom. XLK pulled +$414mm (83p) and XLC +$291mm (92p) over 5 days while XLE bled -$1,823mm (0p) and XLV -$1,199mm (2p). The XLK inflows contradict today's price weakness — that's trapped positioning, not conviction. Rotation call: precious metals/miners and materials are strongest; semiconductor and mega-cap AI are weakest — label: AI hardware fading / high-to-low rotation.

POSITIONING — SPY PCR_vol 1.54 (elevated protection demand) and QQQ 1.19 with skew +11.8%/+11.7% — puts bid across the board. VIX 26.4 sits above its 22.6 MA and VVIX 114.1 above 110, so fear premium is real, not complacency. VIXEQ 51.6 vs VIX 26.4 is a wide ~25-point gap — high single-stock dispersion, low correlation; a stock-pickers' rotation tape.

CROSS-ASSET — Oil +3.29% despite EIA crude stocks at 110.9 vs 150.6 fc build and Cushing drawing -53.4; airlines (JETS -0.88%) couldn't rally into it. Gold's weak 20d (-12.33%) alongside a neutral-to-soft dollar (-0.10%) says real-yield pressure, not a risk trade. Next FOMC: Dec 9, 2026 — Polymarket prices 94% for a 25bp hike (5d +4pp) and only 4% for no change.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 56 (Neutral), but the tape isn't. LRCX -5.68% (tickeron flagged further weakness) led chip equipment lower alongside ORCL -5.13% on hyperscaler balance-sheet doubt; WPM +5.15% caught a BofA Buy with a cut $145 PT. UTES vol 3.2x with +0.17% — muted move, no accumulation. Watch: SLV at 54.9% ATM IV and 2.2x vol into +0.71% (capitulation risk); XLE 0.7x volume with the 5-day -$1,823mm outflow — retail capitulating into a bounce candidate; LRCX -5.68% on the SOXX 200-DMA loss now the momentum break to respect.
